title.zh: ⚡️霍尔木兹海峡船长变「赏金猎人」？月薪达10万美元，单次穿越另获5万美元奖金
title.en: ⚡️霍尔木兹海峡船长变「赏金猎人」？月薪达10万美元，单次穿越另获5万美元奖金

current_state.zh: Intensified Iranian attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz have driven unprecedented hazard pay for crews, a roughly 25-65x spike in freight rates, war-risk insurance as high as $20 million per crossing, and oil flows still about a third below pre-war levels.
